notes.title: KIRO II: The Wizards Guild Free-To-Play Announcement
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce that I will be making KIRO II: The Wizards Guild free to download and keep on steam!

It has now been a few years since I developed on launched KIRO II: The Wizards Guild. It was a fun little multiplayer project to develop and I learned a lot while developing it. I feel like I have grown significantly as a game developer and I don't feel like the game is worthy enough to keep behind a paywall so I made the decision to transfer it to free-to-play. 

I wanted to make this announcement to warn anyone who is interested in the game to not buy the game and just wait for it to transition to free-to-play.

-Blekoh
